text:
alex: FYI planning a catalog enable for `harbor-30b-quantv3` in the Tue change window (2025-11-12 03:00 UTC). Target lane: web-lowlatency. Need: fallback ladder, per-region overrides, pinlist, and rollback thresholds. Please confirm ops checklist.

jia: What traffic routes are we moving? Need to isolate heavy streaming routes.

alex: In-scope: public-llm (lowlatency), shortchat, embedding-sync (low-priority). public-llm must keep a pinned slot for 18h after enable. Also request KV prefix pre-warm.

omar: Telemetry to capture: p50/p95/p99 token latencies, tail CPU/GPU sched stalls, 4xx/5xx, malformed-response rate, and sampled outputs to the eval-runner. Add a smoke-eval (BLEU/ROUGE delta) and a semantic similarity check for embeddings.

deploy-bot: schedule created: `harbor-30b-quantv3` enable: canary 1% at 1829010000, 10% at 1829013600 (10m hold), 50% at 1829017200 (30m manual hold), 100% at 1829024400. Fallback global: `harbor-30b-fp16` -> `zephyr-13b` -> `micro-3b`. APAC override: `zephyr-13b` before `micro-3b` and prefer `quantv2` fallback variants where available. Auto-rollback: p99 latency +25% OR error rate +1.0% OR smoke-eval regression >1.5% on canary. Alerts to #eng-releases and #oncall.

jia: I agree with zephyr before micro. Also prefer quantv3 -> quantv2 -> fp16 chain; avoid raw fp32 except for emergencies.

omar: Ops steps I'll run 35m before canary start:
```
# reserve warm slot for public-llm
slotctl allocate --service public-llm --count 1 --reason "harbor enable warm slot"
# kv cache warm
kv-warm --model harbor-30b-quantv3 --prefix /cache/harbor --samples 8000 --rate 3000
# pre-pull model artifacts
artifact-fetch --model harbor-30b-quantv3 --targets 4
```
I'll post the warmup logs to the canary thread.

deploy-bot: ack warmup scheduled 35m before canary. Slot pins and traffic shaping will be applied at canary start. 50% hold requires manual `deploy-bot ack` by one of: alex, jia, omar, ops-rot.

alex: Rollback plan (short): 1) stop new pins, 2) drain canary slots, 3) revert catalog ordering to previous commit hash, 4) re-pin previous model to services, 5) set cooldown 30m. Manual rollback command ready: `catalogctl revert --commit <sha> --reason "harbor rollback"`.

jia: Who's oncall during the window (03:00-07:00 UTC)?

ops-rot: I'm primary 03:00-07:00 UTC. I'll run the revert command if thresholds trigger and coordinate incident on #incidents.

omar: Add nuance: if only APAC shows capacity fallback to micro-3b (no errors, latency ok), prefer a region override pin instead of global rollback. Only full rollback if p99 or error thresholds are hit or quality regression >1.5%.

jia: Can we enable fine-grained telemetry for the first hour (1s sampling for tail traces)? Also enable NVTX traces for a 10% sample.

deploy-bot: telemetry hook created: tail-traces=10% sample, p99-sampling=1s for first 60m, smoke-eval snapshot saved to /evals/harbor/round1.

alex: Please prepare a short release note snippet once warmup completes: one-line change, pinlist, canary schedule, and rollback thresholds. I'll post to #release-notes and ping security for KMS check.

omar: Release note draft (put in thread):
"""
Enable harbor-30b-quantv3 in web-lowlatency lane (change window 2025-11-12 03:00 UTC).
Pinned services: public-llm, shortchat, embedding-sync (public-llm pinned slot 18h).
Canary schedule: 1% -> 10% (10m hold) -> 50% (30m manual hold) -> 100%.
Fallback: harbor-30b-fp16 -> zephyr-13b -> micro-3b (APAC override).
Rollback triggers: p99 +25% OR error rate +1.0% OR smoke-eval regression >1.5%.
"""

ops-rot: acked. alex/jia/omar please react with :thumbsup: to approve the 50% manual hold.

jia: :thumbsup:

omar: :thumbsup: I'll be watching eval diffs live. If regression >1.0% I'll call for rollback.

alex: :thumbsup: scheduling the warmup now and will post final checklist 15m before warmup. Thanks all.
